name: same event coverage
why: Both stories report the same strike; clustering merges them, so this is not a link.

a.title: Strike at Rotterdam refinery enters fourth day
a.brief: Union workers at the refinery walked out on Monday.

b.title: Rotterdam refinery strike halts fuel exports
b.brief: The walkout has stopped fuel shipments for four days.

name: specific shared theme
why: Distinct events share a specific condition (the same drought) rather than a broad topic.

a.title: Spain's olive harvest falls by half after drought
a.brief: Growers in Andalusia report the smallest crop in a decade.

b.title: Olive oil prices climb in Italy as Mediterranean drought bites
b.brief: Italian bottlers are paying record prices for oil.

name: broad coincidental topic
why: Both are energy stories, but the events are unrelated.

a.title: Solar firm announces new factory in Ohio
a.brief: The plant will make panels for the US market.

b.title: Oil prices slip as demand forecasts weaken
b.brief: Traders pointed to slower Chinese imports.

name: indirect chain
why: A decision in Brussels reaches a Nigerian fuel market through an indirect chain, not a direct effect.

a.title: EU agrees new shipping emissions levy
a.brief: The levy applies to vessels entering EU ports from 2028.

b.title: Nigerian fuel importers warn of higher pump prices
b.brief: Importers say shipping costs are already rising.

name: reversed causal pair
why: The second story is the cause; the first is the effect. Causal type is symmetric, direction is not.

a.title: Floods displace thousands in Bangladesh
a.brief: Monsoon rain has submerged low-lying districts.

b.title: Monsoon rains intensify across South Asia
b.brief: Forecasters warn of another week of heavy rain.
